name: button
gotchas: The visual variant comes entirely from the host attribute (`mat-button`, `mat-raised-button`, `mat-flat-button`, `mat-stroked-button`, `mat-icon-button`, `mat-fab`, `mat-mini-fab`) — MatButton has no `variant` input, so switching styles means swapping the attribute, not binding a property.

`color="primary"|"accent"|"warn"` only has a clearly visible effect on `mat-raised-button`, `mat-flat-button`, the fab variants, and `mat-icon-button` — a plain `mat-button` renders the color as text color only, which is easy to mistake for a bug.
`<a mat-button>` needs `disabled` handled manually (e.g. remove `href` or set `[attr.aria-disabled]`) — anchors don't support the native `disabled` attribute the way `<button>` does.
